I had no problems moving from X-marks to LastPass. Lastpass didn't work well on Android at first, but LogMeIn, Inc. started to rectify most of the issues straight away and also regularly made improvements along the way. The future looked bright (even without boookmark syncing)! Then problems with certain browser and mobile extensions that require a login (eg.Ghostery) started to occur and are ongoing and still haven't been resolved over the last three years. The password entry, or "helper" popup, often appears when the cursor enters, or opens, search bars, when opening certain apps and address boxes on certain sites, and lists potential sites and their associated usernames/profiles/e-mail addresses, and sometimes even fills in names and passwords automatically on other sites in search or address bars! In early/mid 2021 there have been bigger changes, like having to pay for Premium because you need to use Lastpass on two machines. Other changes include the inability to choose a payment method you trust, or have an account with, no longer being able to choose the method of payment and no longer being able to choose the payment currency. This means that you cannot gift a years Premium, you cannot use PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, iBank, Bitcoin or even a simple bank transfer. Quality has seriously diminished over the last year (2020/2021), I used to say that LastPass was worthy of taking over X-Marks, but now I'm concerned for them to have just one of my bookmarks, let alone a few hundred of my passwords. I have started to look elsewhere for for this simple, but important, aid.
